subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should this workflow be redesigned around canonical `accessGroups` with explicit pre-auth activation, or should OpenClaw intentionally support a second fixed per-sender grouping taxonomy and automatic trusted-hook activation?
rationale: Implementation evidence cannot decide the permanent config/API model or whether blocked-message content may cross the admission boundary by default.

options.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
options.body: Retain the access-request workflow, use `accessGroups` and `accessGroup:<name>`, derive matched-group metadata, and require explicit activation for content-bearing hooks.

options.title: Approve Parallel Trust Tiers
options.body: Accept the six fixed labels and grouped allowlist objects only with explicit compatibility, upgrade, and security documentation.

options.title: Split Or Pause
options.body: Separate the generic pre-auth hook from grouping and access-request automation, or pause the broad proposal until the complete direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
recommendation.body: Retain the access-request workflow, use `accessGroups` and `accessGroup:<name>`, derive matched-group metadata, and require explicit activation for content-bearing hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the canonical access-group, shared ingress, allowlist, and plugin SDK decision surface.
